intro.title: Intervals
intro.text: An interval is the distance between two notes. Count the letter names, including both ends: C to E is C-D-E, a 3rd. C to C is an octave (8th).

intro.title: On the staff
intro.text: 2nds go line to space, 3rds line to line, 5ths skip two lines. Bars 1–7 go up from C: 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th, octave. Then mixed.
